name: Elemental Mastery
title: Elemental Mastery
text:
Elemental Mastery is an attribute that enhances Elemental Reactions.
Upon triggering a reaction, Elemental Mastery causes the following effects:
* For Overloaded, Superconduct, Electro-Charged, Burning, Shattered, Swirl, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Crystallize, and Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG is increased.
* For Melt and Vaporize, the triggering attack damage is multiplied.
* For Aggravate and Spread, an Additive Base DMG Bonus is added to the triggering attack damage.
* For Crystallize, the shield's DMG absorption is increased.
Elemental Mastery starts at 0 for most playable characters, excluding Lauma and Nefer whose Elemental Mastery begin at 200 and 100 respectively.
## Elemental Mastery Formula
The higher a unit's Elemental Mastery, the stronger the elemental reactions the character can release.
The \% \text{EM Bonus} is calculated depending on the reaction:
*Increases damage of Vaporize and Melt by A.
*Increases damage of Overloaded, Superconduct, Electro-Charged, Burning, Shattered, Swirl, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon by B.
*Increases the DMG Bonus provided by Aggravate and Spread by C.
*Increases damage of Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Crystallize, and Stellar-Conduct by D.
*Increases damage absorption of shields created by Crystallize by E.
*Where A, B, C, D, and E are:
:A = 2.78 \times \frac{\text{EM}}{\text{EM} + 1400} \times 100 \%
:B = 16 \times \frac{\text{EM}}{\text{EM} + 2000} \times 100 \%
:C = 5 \times \frac{\text{EM}}{\text{EM} + 1200} \times 100 \%
:D = 6 \times \frac{\text{EM}}{\text{EM} + 2000} \times 100 \%
:E = 4.44 \times \frac{\text{EM}}{\text{EM} + 1400} \times 100 \%
These values are used in damage or shield health calculations as:
:\text{Reaction Multiplier} = (1 + \% \text{EM Bonus} + \% \text{Reaction Bonus})
